## Overdue reminders
Runs every day at 09:00 UTC (or by hand with "Execute workflow").

1. Signed GET to Convex `/n8n/overdue-loans`: approved loans past their end date with no reminder sent today.
2. One email per borrower. A failed send is recorded as `failed`, not dropped.
3. Signed POST to `/n8n/reminders` with the result per loan. Each result carries the idempotency key `loanId:YYYY-MM-DD`, so retries never create a second row.

HTTP calls retry 3 times, 5 s apart. If they still fail, the error workflow reports it.
